action: Measured why the compiled clips play rotated: the stock clips declare pelvis as a child of root_motion, our merged clips declare it as a root bone (tools/clip_rig_shape_probe.py on artifacts/live-shiv-merge2/out/item_run_center.dmx against the pak01 decompile: 168 vs 140 bones, parent differs ['pelvis'], rest identical). Compiling the game's own DMX through the same document, skeleton and compiler round-trips exactly; compiling our merged DMX comes back rigidly rotated (x,y,z)->(y,z,-x) - pelvis (-6.2,-2.3,53.1) becomes (-2.3,53.1,-6.2). Restoring the parent link without moving any rest head makes the compile exact again (item_run_center pelvis, head, hand_R, tail_0, tail_end identical before and after). That rotation is the owner's lift, the tilt when he looks up, the horizontal slide entries and the wrong tail angle.
